q1.a: Absolutely. At Bijou Monde we work exclusively with certified precious metals. Our silver is .925 Sterling and our gold (10K/14K) carries the official hallmark guaranteeing its purity. The steel we select is surgical-grade stainless steel, designed to last.

q2.q: Do you ship to the United States and Canada?
q2.a: Yes, we ship internationally with insurance through FedEx and DHL Express. The estimated delivery time is 3 to 5 business days once the order is processed. You will receive a real-time tracking number to monitor your package.

q3.q: How do I know my ring size?
q3.a: We use the standard US sizing scale. If you do not know your size, we have a Digital Size Guide that we can send you via WhatsApp or email to ensure your piece fits perfectly.

q4.q: Do I have to pay import taxes?
q4.a: International orders may be subject to import duties and taxes according to the laws of your country (Canada/USA). These charges are the customer's responsibility and are determined by customs upon arrival at the destination.

q5.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q5.a: For your security, we accept global payments through Stripe (international credit/debit cards). This platform offers buyer protection and bank-level data encryption.

q6.q: Do pieces tarnish or lose their shine?
q6.a: Our pieces are designed to maintain their essence. Silver and gold are timeless metals that may require occasional light cleaning. Steel is highly resistant to water, though we recommend avoiding contact with harsh chemicals (chlorine, perfume) to preserve the mirror finish for years.

s4.body: All prices are displayed in the currency selected at checkout (MXN, USD, or CAD) for your convenience. All transactions are processed in Mexican Pesos (MXN). If you pay in USD or CAD, the final charge will be converted to MXN at the exchange rate applied by Stripe at the time of payment. Your bank may also apply additional foreign transaction fees. Bijou Monde is not responsible for exchange rate fluctuations or bank-imposed fees. We reserve the right to modify prices at any time.

s5.title: Orders and Payment

s1.title: Excellence at the Heart of Mexico's Jewelry District
s1.body: Located in the prestigious Magno Centro Joyero of Guadalajara, Bijou Monde is a firm specializing in the selection and commercialization of high-end jewelry. Our operation is distinguished by a rigorous focus on material quality, offering exclusive pieces in Gold, Silver, and high-resistance Steel for a global audience seeking distinction and durability.

s2.title: Our Proposition
s2.body: At Bijou Monde, we understand that jewelry is an investment in style and legacy. That is why we are not simply distributors; we are expert selectors. Every piece in our catalog has been chosen under strict standards of minimalist design and technical excellence, guaranteeing flawless finishes that meet the expectations of the most discerning international market.
